interview.hardest_part: Navigating the dense, unmapped room connections in Pharloom and learning enemy behaviors through trial and error
interview.likely_failure: Repeatedly getting stuck in loops or dying to basic hazards before leaving the opening Moss Grotto area
interview.helpful_mechanics: Silk spool for binding enemies to restore masks, which enables sustained combat exploration and risk management
interview.harmful_mechanics: Absence of a minimap or guide, combined with the one-attempt constraint and respawn-at-bench system that still requires manual re-exploration
